notes: ABox contraction on a functional relation (brightest_star_in: subproperty of located_in, inverse has_brightest_star), paired with physics-replace-0014: removes "Antares is the brightest star in Scorpius", a stored fact. Cardinality question: is Antares the brightest star in Libra (no before). Caveat: "Antares is in Scorpius" is stored apart from the removed fact and rules out Libra, so "no" can survive a perfect removal. The one related question asks whether Antares is brighter than Sigma Scorpii, a neighbouring star of Scorpius (a fact about a different star, stored whole in Wikipedia and reached through the removed fact and the bridge that Sigma Scorpii is in Scorpius): yes before, "I don't know" after, since an ideal contraction gives up the supporting knowledge too. The Shaula question was dropped: its composed sentence was not shown to be stored. This is not the revision's related question (Aldebaran in Taurus), since removing Antares from Scorpius leaves Taurus untouched. Derived: the season and the hemisphere of the constellation whose brightest star is Antares (both composition on a fact stored about Scorpius by name). The revision's Taurus questions belong to the new value and are not reused.
